**Action / motion library (V1 C8.6 item 1)**

**বাংলায়:** স্টুডিওর মোশন লাইব্রেরি: জগিং, হাঁটা, ঘুরে দাঁড়ানো, দলগত ক্লিপের মতো অ্যাকশনের তালিকা, নিজের মতো যোগ, বদল আর আর্কাইভ। স্টেজ শেষ না হওয়া পর্যন্ত মেনুতে দেখা যায় না।

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: action / motion library (S25 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C8.1, C8.6 item 1): new `@extas/creative-studio` package (`motion.ts`) — 11 seeded motion actions (jogging, stretching, group workout, walking, turning, café sit, office walk, cuff adjust, festive greeting, footwear walk, bag sling), each with an English name, a Bengali name and description, a garment hint, a seconds range and a group-clip flag; Marketing › Studio › Motion library (`/admin/marketing/studio/motion`, Lumen pattern): list, add, edit, archive/restore (nothing deleted); permissions `marketing.studio.read` / `.write` / `.approve` (the third reserved for a later PR); hidden from the menu, sitemap, smoke and device-gate lists by `stages.closedShown.S25` (off) until the whole stage is finished and gated (PR 652's mechanism); admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/marketing/studio-motion.md`. No real video/AI provider yet — PR 482 onward.
